title: cota tinctoria subsp. parnassica
intro: Cota tinctoria subsp. parnassica, commonly known as Parnassian Cota, is a subspecies of the Cota tinctoria plant, a type of flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Parnassian Cota include its ability to calm and soothe the skin, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
